preconditions.description: The input n is a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The result is at least 1, as there is always at least one perfect square number (1) that sums to any positive integer.

postconditions.expression: exists(i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1)) such that n == i*i
postconditions.description: If n is a perfect square, the result is 1, as n itself is the sum of itself.

postconditions.expression: exists(i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1)) such that n == sum(i*i for i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1))
postconditions.description: If n is not a perfect square, the result is the minimum number of perfect square numbers that sum to n.
